title: gcb-cocycle-tester widget params
description: Bespoke widget for §1 of galois-cohomology-and-brauer: pick a candidate value of phi(sigma) in Q(i)^* from a dropdown of norm-one and non-norm-one targets, then click test-and-trivialise. The widget reports whether phi extends to a 1-cocycle (norm-one check) and, if so, exhibits an explicit Hilbert-90 witness alpha with sigma(alpha)/alpha = phi(sigma). Shape: select + button + multi-line readout, with bracketing prose rows. Doesn't fit any shared slug.
